title: Vesper and the Uniform
author: Hazel Yarrow
blurb: Sebastian Voss, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
